svg.text: 27 pieces · XP mode uses the phrases and XP heads · X′ mode uses the phrases, bars and X′ heads · every slot takes all the shapes the game allows there
white spoke: orientation key, one way in
dark spokes (A): the plug tip, deepest in the socket
pale spokes (B): near the base of the plug
12 positions, evenly spaced every 30.0°, on a 18.7 mm core
cream cards: heads that fit XP pieces
Heads for X′ mode — fit only X′ pieces
Heads for XP mode — fit only XP pieces
